name: Prime Cuts

tenures.source: Earned the number one tag team challengership by beating Old School on "Rage for Order," 8 January 1999.

caption: A heavyweight tag team that held the number one tag team challengership through early 1999.

name: Old School

tenures.source: Lost the number one tag team challengership to Prime Cuts on "Rage for Order," 8 January 1999.

caption: A heavyweight tag team that lost its number one tag team challengership to Prime Cuts.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (old-school-faw); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: Los Lobos

tenures.source: The stable's captain and four members are named together defending Guchi Guaro against a locker-room confrontation on "Rage for Order," 8 January 1999.

caption: A Cuban-themed heavyweight stable captained by Guchi Guaro, publicly humiliated when a stablemate was ambushed and violated with a burrito on "Rage for Order."

name: Expendable Youth

tenures.source: Billed as an undefeated tag team in the promotion's own all-time rankings, 8-9 January 1999; both members joined a pre-match brawl on "Rage for Order."

caption: An undefeated tag team as of the promotion's own 8 January 1999 all-time rankings.

name: Great Northern Army

tenures.source: Named the promotion's reigning Gang Warfare Champions, with Brad Napalm as its leader, in the year-end awards (3 January 1999) and a falls-count-anywhere title defense at the Ides of January Supercard (15 January 1999).

name: Zombies Unlimited

name: Dawg Pound
